B4 admin: before / after

12 admin pages, as coded today (before) and with the UI System tokens (after). Real CSS variables from src/styles/globals.css, real LBC font, mock data in the real row shape. Visual only: no server action or behaviour from Phase 1.1 changes. Long forms and tables are abridged to representative sections and rows; the rest follows the same rules.

Audit: where admin breaks the rules today

RuleHitsWhere
Text under 11px99 × text-[10px] (header menu label, review avatar, audit entity id, media pickers)
Contrast < 4.5:110text-white/20…40 on panels: 1.9–3.8:1 (FAQ / legal editors, hero video, audit ids)
Off-token colour literals20#171717 #2e2e2e #0f0f0f #11151d, rgba glass in header, shell and forms
Palette colours, not tokens98emerald / amber / sky / red / yellow status colours in 20 files
Controls under 44px94Button sm 31×, icon-sm 12×, size-8 overrides; checkboxes 16px on desktop
Radius off role90panels and tables at 8px; roles are card 12 / panel 16 / field 8
Off-token surface alpha249bg-white/[0.0x] instead of --bg-* (border-white/8 equals --line)

Every file:line is in .planning/design/b4-admin-audit.md. Tokens and rules: ui.config.json, src/styles/globals.css, DESIGN.md.

What changes (5 lines)

  • Shell: pill bar becomes a left sidebar on desktop, same links and groups; phone keeps a top bar. Needs your call (decision 1).
  • Density: big panelled headers and 32px stat cards become a 24px title, one stat strip and ~52px table rows.
  • Colour: 98 Tailwind palette colours and 20 hex/rgba literals go to tokens; status uses the brand-safe tints with a dot.
  • Rules: every text 11px or more, 10 low-contrast spots fixed, radius by role (card 12, field 8, pill), surfaces on --bg-*.
  • Targets: row icons and small buttons are 36px with a 44px hit area (phone: 44px). Needs your call (decision 2). No server action or 1.1 behaviour is touched.

Decisions for Koss

  1. Admin navigation. Recommended: sidebar on desktop (as ui.config.json and DESIGN.md say). Alternative: keep the current top pill bar, re-skinned.
  2. Dense table controls. Recommended: 36px visible with a 44px hit area on desktop, 44px on phone. Alternative: literal 44px everywhere (rows grow to ~64px, table shows ~30% fewer rows).
  3. Shared components (Button, Checkbox, Table, Select, Badge) need small changes; I list them in the audit file and will not edit them. The controller sequences those. Until then B4 uses local classes.
